title: Unmanic
descript: Unmanic is a library optimisation tool: point it at a folder of media, install the plugins you want (remux, convert to H.265, normalise audio, move subtitles), and it processes new files automatically with the bundled FFmpeg. A single container watches the library, runs the conversions in the background and keeps its configuration and history in the application data folder.
release_note: 1. First release: Unmanic 0.4.1 from Docker Hub as a non-root container. Plugin-based media library optimisation with FFmpeg, watched library folder and configuration in the application data folder.
important: Requires DockerEngine (installed automatically if missing). Mount your media into DockerAppData/unmanicdocker/library, open the UI and pick the plugins you need - the first run downloads the plugin repository from the internet. Conversions are CPU-heavy; schedule them for the night if the NAS is also used for streaming. History and settings live in .../config. Plain HTTP; use a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it to the internet.

zh-cn.descript: Unmanic 是媒体库优化工具：指向一个媒体目录，装上需要的插件（重封装、转 H.265、音量标准化、字幕整理……），它就会用内置 FFmpeg 自动处理新文件。一个容器持续监视媒体库、后台转码，配置与历史都保存在应用数据目录。
zh-cn.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺失时应用中心会自动安装）。把媒体挂到 DockerAppData/unmanicdocker/library，打开界面选择需要的插件——首次运行会联网下载插件仓库。转码很吃 CPU，NAS 同时还要串流的话建议安排在夜间。历史与设置保存在 .../config。界面为纯 HTTP，暴露到公网前请配置带 TLS 的反向代理。
zh-cn.release_note: 1. 首个版本：基于 Docker Hub 的 Unmanic 0.4.1，以非 root 容器运行。插件式媒体库优化，内置 FFmpeg，监视媒体目录；配置与历史保存在应用数据目录。

zh-hk.descript: Unmanic 是媒體庫優化工具：指向一個媒體目錄，裝上需要的插件（重新封裝、轉 H.265、音量標準化、字幕整理……），它就會用內建 FFmpeg 自動處理新檔案。一個容器持續監視媒體庫、後台轉碼，設定與歷史都保存在應用資料目錄。
zh-hk.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺少時應用中心會自動安裝）。把媒體掛到 DockerAppData/unmanicdocker/library，開啟介面選擇需要的插件——首次執行會連網下載插件倉庫。轉碼很吃 CPU，NAS 同時還要串流的話建議安排在夜間。歷史與設定保存在 .../config。介面為純 HTTP，公開到互聯網前請配置帶 TLS 的反向代理。
zh-hk.release_note: 1. 首個版本：基於 Docker Hub 的 Unmanic 0.4.1，以非 root 容器運行。插件式媒體庫優化，內建 FFmpeg，監視媒體目錄；設定與歷史保存在應用資料目錄。

data_notes: `/config` keeps the Unmanic database, plugins and logs; `/library` (mounted from `.../library`) is the media folder it scans and rewrites.
design_notes: **Runs as uid 1000.** The entrypoint detects a non-root start and skips its own user switch.
**FFmpeg inside the image.** No host dependencies; conversions use the bundled binaries.
limitations: - Conversions are CPU-heavy and can take hours on 4K files.
- The plugin repository is downloaded from the internet on first start.
- The UI is plain HTTP; use a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it to the internet.
